purpose: Teach: 名画/切なく/点滅/水温/霜/躾/隠せ/家出

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、美術の授業で、本気で、絶対、名画、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku — we definitely learned all those masterpieces in art class, right?
lines.style: Quick, bright energy. Slight conspiratorial lean forward. Testing his attention. A little performative certainty masking something softer underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。卒業、本気で、絶対、近づくと、絶対、切なく、絶対、なるよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. It hits different when graduation gets close, you know?
lines.style: Soft, distant. The words come slower than usual. Looking past her rather than at her. A tenderness he's not quite admitting to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校舎の電気、本気で、絶対、点滅、絶対、してるよ、リク
lines.en: The school lights have been flickering all week, have you noticed?
lines.style: Animated, observant. Bouncing slightly on the words. Drawing him back into the present moment with small details. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: プールの、本気で、絶対、水温、絶対、低かったぜ、桜
lines.en: The pool water's been freezing cold lately, man.
lines.style: Dry, almost rueful. A small laugh buried in the tone. Shifting weight. Acknowledging something mundane that somehow matters. Not complaining, just noting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今朝、本気で、絶対、運動場、絶対、霜、絶対、降りてたよね、リク
lines.en: There was frost all over the schoolyard this morning. Did you see it?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Slowing pace. Speaking to the moment rather than performing for him. A gentleness that feels like noticing something together.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、躾、絶対、厳しいんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandfather's discipline is no joke, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but weighted. Not complaining—just stating something true about his world. A quick glance to see if she understands what that means.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、テストで、絶対、感情を、絶対、隠せ、絶対、ない、絶対、こと、絶対、あるよね、リク
lines.en: You — there are times in tests where you just can't hide what you're feeling, right?
lines.style: Knowing, slightly teasing. But underneath the edge is something protective. Watching him carefully. A joke that's also a real question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、家出、絶対、なんて、絶対、絶対するなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't you ever do something like running away, okay?
lines.style: Sudden earnest shift. Closer. The teasing drops completely. Direct eye contact. A moment of unguarded seriousness before he catches himself and pulls back slightly.
